[SWS_DM_00413] Check supported DataIdentifier in active session
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04275, RS_Diag_04226
⌈
On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), a requested DataIden-
tifier shall be considered as supported in active session if and only if the DataIdentifier
is supported according to [SWS_DM_00409] and the
DiagnosticDataByIdenti-
fier
.
accessPermission
references by its
DiagnosticAccessPermission.di-
agnosticSession
the active diagnostic session in the DM.
⌋
